meta.title: Prompt Fusion
meta.description: One button, automatic domain and depth, faithful structured prompts with undo. Produced by 禾杨智绘工作室（绍兴市柯桥区禾杨智绘软件开发工作室）; developed by Merziller (子墨).

ui.hint: Match detail to the draft. Simple requests get a verified light edit; complex requests are rewritten and reviewed for intent and constraints. Failure retains the original. Does not send. Model charges may apply.
ui.busyHint: Generating. Stop keeps the original; after application this same button becomes Undo enhancement.
ui.applyingHint: Waiting for the editor to confirm this change; Undo enhancement follows.
ui.applyUnconfirmed: The editor did not confirm this change. Its pending undo record expired; check the current draft before retrying.
ui.projectionUnavailable: The draft contains an opaque quote or incomplete reference coordinates. No edit was made. Enhance plain text before adding this reference.
ui.undoHint: Enhanced. Click to restore the original draft. Nothing was sent.
ui.stale: Draft changed; your new edits were retained. Click again to enhance the current draft.
ui.unchanged: Review accepted the original wording; no change was needed.
ui.needsModel: Select an available model in the host settings. Your original draft was retained.
ui.retained: The rewrite did not finish or pass validation. Your original draft was retained.
ui.fidelityRetained: The rewrite did not pass intent and constraint checks. Original retained. Adjust the wording and retry; nothing was sent.
ui.formatRetained: The model returned an invalid format. Original retained. Retry or switch models; nothing was sent.
ui.interrupted: A view change interrupted enhancement. Original retained. Return to enhance again.
ui.networkRetained: The model connection or service failed. Your draft was retained. Check the network, proxy and provider before retrying; this is not a content-validation failure.
ui.timeoutRetained: The model response timed out. Your draft was retained; try again later.
ui.authRetained: The model provider reported an authentication, access or balance issue. Your draft was retained; check the provider settings.
ui.rateRetained: The model provider rate-limited this request. Your draft was retained; try again later.
ui.sessionRetained: The host session connection or access check did not pass. Your draft was retained. Check the host session; this does not indicate a model balance issue.
ui.applied: The draft was enhanced and checked. Click the same button to undo.
ui.failed: Enhancement did not complete; original retained.
